name: orbit
description: Orbit — see what's really yours to spend, and keep more of it

scripts.dev: npm run fix:esbuild && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run fix:esbuild && npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
